capabilities: Reorder files and folders by dragging rows in the file explorer
Arrange a folder's children in a dialog, with sorting by name or date as a starting point
Move items up, down or to the ends via context-menu actions and bindable commands
Store all orders in one editable plain-text note inside the vault
Repair a corrupted order note without losing data
extras: From version 0.5.0 it requires Obsidian 1.13 or newer (older versions get 0.4.2); it wraps a non-public file explorer API, so app updates could break ordering. Obsidian staff have not manually reviewed it.
intentEvidence: Put the folders and notes inside a folder in the order you want, by dragging them in the file explorer itself.
problem: Obsidian sorts explorer items only by fixed rules like name or date, so a custom arrangement forces number prefixes or renames, and any order kept in .obsidian/ is lost by sync setups that exclude that folder.
summary: Manual ordering of files and folders in the file explorer via drag-and-drop, stored as a plain-text note inside the vault.
